pages.title: Nutrient Broth
pages.text: A warm, rich medium for growing cells. Sugar provides energy, bone meal provides minerals, and a zeolite catalyst keeps the chemistry steady. It smells faintly sweet. Left uncovered for even a moment, it clouds with whatever life drifts into it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Life needs food. In the Bioreactor, I combined sugar, bone meal and water with a zeolite catalyst, and the broth supported growth.
